title: add downgrade guard, version pinning, backup/restore and transactional schema migrations for private-installer
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: private installer upgrades were failing in staging when customers attempted a rollback after a schema change. This PR adds a downgrade guard and version-pinning surface for Private Installer deployments, formalizes transactional schema migrations, and wires backup/restore checks into the upgrade flow. Summary of changes: 1) Add 'downgrade guard' that prevents automatic downgrades when irreversible migrations are detected and surfaces clear rollback instructions. 2) Introduce explicit version pinning for helm charts and terraform modules used by the private installer so upgrades are deterministic. 3) Implement transactional PostgreSQL schema migrations with a migration manager and safe rollback SQL generation. 4) Add backup/restore integration tests to the installer CI and a verification step that validates backups before applying migrations. 5) Update helm charts to include 'upgradeStrategy' annotations and migrationJob templates. 6) Update Terraform modules to pin provider and module versions and add an 'upgrade_lock' resource. 7) Add docs and runbook snippets for on-call and customer-facing upgrade guidance. Checklist: - [x] migration manager implementation - [x] backup/restore e2e tests - [x] helm + terraform pinning and templates - [x] docs and runbook - [x] reviewers approved
Notes: Implementation targets Private (VPC/on-prem) customers first, changes are backward compatible for existing installs that do not opt into transactional migrations. Rollback path now requires manual confirmation if irreversible migrations are detected; we include an automated dry-run to surface SQL changes ahead of time.
commits: add migration manager and transactional runner
add downgrade guard and version pinning checks
helm: add migrationJob template and upgradeStrategy annotations
terraform: pin providers/modules and add upgrade_lock resource
review_comments: Connor Liu: Left a few nits on migration manager error handling; can we ensure we don't swallow PG errors? Suggested adding explicit logging and returning wrapped errors.
Aisha Patel (author): Addressed the error handling comment and added a test to assert that SQL errors propagate through the runner. Also added structured logging for migration steps.
Maria Gomez: CI flaked on e2e backup test (timeout) — please add retry/backoff. Also requested clarification on how 'upgrade_lock' works during parallel upgrades.
Aisha Patel (author): Added retry with exponential backoff to the e2e test and documented the upgrade_lock semantics in the runbook. Updated terraform module comments to clarify behavior.

Ethan Park: Approved after verifying helm templates won't affect existing non-migration deployments. Recommended adding a note in release notes about manual confirmation requirement for irreversible migrations.
CI: initial run failed on linter (helm chart schema) — fixed by updating Chart.yaml and re-running CI. Final CI run: all checks passed.
release_notes: Private Installer: Add downgrade guard and deterministic version pinning for helm and terraform; introduce transactional schema migrations with backup/restore verification. Admins must run the provided backup verification step before upgrades that include irreversible migrations. See private-installer/docs/upgrade-runbook.md for details.
